plain_text:
After clicking the Submit button, the user will see a confirmation notice stating that the form
will no longer be editable once it has been submitted. Users must select Submit on this window
to complete the submission process (see fig. 28).
semantic_text: After clicking the Submit button, the user will see a confirmation notice stating that the form will no longer be editable once it has been submitted. Users must select Submit on this window to complete the submission process (see fig. 28).

plain_text:
Users can review responses but are not able to make any changes once the form has been
submitted. The Reset, Save, and Save & Continue buttons will become disabled (see fig.29).
semantic_text: Users can review responses but are not able to make any changes once the form has been submitted. The Reset, Save, and Save & Continue buttons will become disabled (see fig.29).

plain_text:
IMPORTANT! The GEER Annual Performance Report may not be resubmitted. Once a
submission is made within the Data Collection Tool, that submission will be marked as final.
Please ensure data are accurate and complete before submission.
